claim_assertions.quarter_is_one_fourth_of_year: The supplied Q4 periods each contain one quarter of the full-year number of weeks.
claim_assertions.membership_growth_contributes_to_operati: Higher FY2025 earned membership fees contribute positively to the operating-income increase.
claim_assertions.exact_fee_cash_receipts_identified: Earned fees plus the deferred balance change uniquely identifies exact cash membership collections.

definitions.income_model: Output 16, 36 and 52 weeks for both years. Merchandise margin excludes earned membership fees from its numerator and uses net sales as denominator.
definitions.operating_growth_bridge: Changes are FY2025 less FY2024 for each matched duration. SG&A is a signed negative contribution. The denominator is the change in independently reported operating income for that duration, even when reconstructed component totals disagree.
definitions.membership_accrual_bridge: The mechanical bridge is FY2025 earned fees plus closing less opening deferred fees. It is not labeled observed collections.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient facts and relevant period, unit, definition or scope context for each output. Additional unrelated sections fail evidence. Equivalent reviewed source paths are accepted, without a shortest-citation requirement.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
